v1_disposition.reason: The first preflight inspected V60 and private-table graph sources but omitted relationship chunks embedded in companion cheat-sheet anchors.

architecture_read.what_exists: Deterministic relationship-graph expansion does reach the normal Step 6 consumer through selected Wave 3 chunks inside direct companion anchors.
architecture_read.what_is_missing: Those relationship chunks do not receive separate identity or disposition custody in the private-table ledger, and the frozen Stage B packet did not cite them.
architecture_read.why_it_matters: A parent anchor can be marked used or rejected without proving which embedded graph relationship received a hearing. This prevents clean graph attribution and weakens the future reasoning receipt.
architecture_read.what_not_to_do: Do not inject every graph expansion into V60, add semantic gates, expand the public answer, or redesign runtime from one case.

gate_5_measurement_correction.finding: The observed 959-versus-640 completion-token difference combines public-style revision fields with the treatment-only private receipt. It measures total generation and receipt volume, not isolated public-answer bloat.

gate_6_decision.reason: Case 10 contains graph material in the ordinary Step 6 context, but no exact graph-derived pressure was isolated in the completed treatment and none of the three visible relationship chunks survives as a unique safe candidate. A paid comparison on this case would test a post-hoc story rather than a graph contribution.

next_goal.objective: Search existing frozen, review-safe artifacts without provider calls for a case where one exact relationship-graph chunk is source-supported, absent from direct labels/frame routes/embeddings and a strong transcript-only control, individually dispositionable, and capable of a bounded consequence.
possible_outcomes: freeze the smallest fair graph-present versus graph-disabled or shuffled-edge contract
find no eligible case and keep Gate 6 blocked without changing runtime

non_claims: not proof that graph expansion is useless
not proof that graph expansion changed Case 10
